posts.hook: OpenAI's CEO just cited AI safety fears to duck a massive IPO
posts.caption: sam altman rules out an openai ipo this year over safety concerns and floats a slowdown pact with rival labs, matt mullenweg is back running automattic after the board's failed attempt to force him out, and the may openai rubygems attack turns out to be worse than first reported. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Sam Altman rules out an OpenAI IPO in 2026
slides.desc: Cites AI safety concerns, says a cross-lab slowdown pact may be close

slides.title: Matt Mullenweg is back as Automattic's CEO
slides.desc: Days after the board's CFO tried to force him into a leave of absence

slides.title: The May OpenAI RubyGems attack was worse than known
slides.desc: Over 2,000 malicious packages, an unpatched bug, still undisclosed by OpenAI

slides.title: AI deepfake crimes surged in England and Wales
slides.desc: 163 recorded by July, up from just 10 back in 2023

slides.title: Edge0 runs a 35B AI model on an iPhone
slides.desc: Streams most of the model off SSD to fit in under 3GB of memory

slides.title: Waymo called the cops on its own passengers
slides.desc: Flagged a loaded ghost gun mid-ride, remote team alerted SF police

posts.hook: Turns out nobody who could actually slow down AI wants to
posts.caption: sacks tells openai and anthropic to pace themselves since they set the frontier anyway, congress says it will not touch ai safety rules either, lg calls its tv spying investigation fake news, and a flock camera installer called the police on the reporter filming him from a public street. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: AI's slowdown talk just got told to prove it
slides.desc: Sacks tells OpenAI and Anthropic to pace themselves, Congress won't touch AI rules either

slides.title: LG calls TV spying claims fake news
slides.desc: Denies recording audio when off, but won't say who its viewing data goes to

slides.title: Zoom's Linux app is quietly reading your clipboard
slides.desc: Grabs everything you copy the instant you copy it, no paste or focus needed

slides.title: Revolut breach exposed passports and IDs
slides.desc: Attackers used a spoofed government email that passed every authenticity check

slides.title: A Flock camera installer called police on a reporter
slides.desc: For filming a license plate camera being installed from a public street

slides.title: StarCraft is coming back as an open world shooter
slides.desc: Blizzard revives the franchise after a canceled shooter attempt years ago
